definitions.gloss: used item; secondhand goods; pre-owned product
definitions.explanation: an item that has been previously owned or used; sold at a lower price than new items

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}は{中古品|ちゅうこひん}です。
{中古品|ちゅうこひん}でも{状態|じょうたい}がよければ{問題|もんだい}ない。
examples.english: Even a used item is fine if it's in good condition.

examples.japanese: {中古品|ちゅうこひん}を{買|か}ったら{半額|はんがく}で{済|す}んだ。
examples.english: I bought a used item and it cost only half the price.

notes:
FORMS:
{中古|ちゅうこ} (used, secondhand) + {品|ひん} (item, goods)

RELATED WORDS:
- {新品|しんぴん} (brand new item) - opposite
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ} (used car)
- {中古|ちゅうこ}マンション (pre-owned apartment)
- リサイクルショップ (secondhand shop)

USAGE:
{中古|ちゅうこ} alone can function as a no-adjective meaning "used" or "secondhand." Adding {品|ひん} emphasizes that it's a product or goods.

ALTERNATE READING:
The word {中古|ちゅうこ} is sometimes read as ちゅうぶる in certain dialects or older usage.
